attempts.summary: Published node2's private-network HTTP service (port 8080) through node1's OpenWrt firewall so node3 can reach it on node1's management address (10.100.198.10) port 80, while the service itself remains bound only to the private 192.168.50.0/24 network and is unreachable directly from node3. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with verified boot-identity changes and full post-restart recovery.
